title: WeatherArchive-Bench: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Historical Weather Archives
authors: Yongan Yu; Xianda Du; Qingchen Hu; Jiahao Liang; Jingwei Ni; Dan Qiang; Kaiyu Huang; Grant McKenzie; Renee Sieber; Fengran Mo
why_relevant: Introduces a RAG benchmark over noisy OCR'd historical archives with archaic terminology, evaluating retrieval and reasoning robustness under unreliable, noisy evidence.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (historical weather archives); focus is on benchmark construction rather than general robustness methods.
